title: Meta AI at Arabic Hate Speech 2022: MultiTask Learning with Self-Correction for Hate Speech Classification
reasoning: The paper participates in a shared task for Arabic Fine-Grained Hate Speech Detection. One of the core subtasks (HSC) involves benchmarking the model's ability to classify hate speech into specific categories, one of which is 'Religion/Belief'. This constitutes a component of benchmarking related to religion and religious intolerance.
